org-founded.statement: SYNTHETIC: Harborview Community Kitchen began serving meals in 2019.

meals-2025.statement: SYNTHETIC: the kitchen served about 12400 meals in 2025.

kitchen-size.statement: SYNTHETIC: the kitchen operates from a 900 square foot rented hall.

year1-projection.statement: SYNTHETIC: the plan projects serving 15000 meals in the first grant year.

seat-expansion.statement: SYNTHETIC: new ovens are projected to add 40 meal seats per service.

match-pledge.statement: SYNTHETIC: the board commits 400 volunteer hours as match in the grant year.

report-commitment.statement: SYNTHETIC: the kitchen commits to quarterly spending reports to the funder.

budget-premise.statement: SYNTHETIC planned-budget premise: grant request 15000.00 USD covers two convection ovens 12000.00, installation 2500.00, and training 500.00; board match 3000.00; total project 18000.00.
